notes: New observed 95% CL helioscope-type limit from NuSTAR solar disk-center observations (Feb 2020 solar minimum): g_agamma < 7.3e-12 GeV^-1, flat for m_a <~ 4e-7 eV (encoded from the low end of the paper's exclusion plot at ~1e-11 eV to 4e-7 eV). Limit weakens at higher masses due to loss of conversion coherence, remaining stronger than CAST up to m_a ~ 3.4e-4 eV; the third point is an approximate endpoint where the limit meets the CAST level (~6.6e-11 GeV^-1) inferred from Fig. 1 and text, not an explicitly tabulated value. Detailed curve between 4e-7 and 3.4e-4 eV not available from text. No dark-matter assumption: axions are sourced by the Sun (helioscope-like), so no local DM density applies.
